text: Consider singleton MCP server with multiplexed transport (HTTP/SSE) instead of per-client stdio processes. Currently each MCP client (VS Code, Copilot CLI) spawns its own backlogit mcp process, each with an independent sql.DB connection pool against the same backlogit.db. A single long-lived server process with HTTP or SSE transport would eliminate multi-process SQLite contention entirely. NOTE: This is a contingency item -- only pursue if fixes 1-4 (busy_timeout increase, write-retry wrapper, BEGIN IMMEDIATE transactions, batched rehydration) prove insufficient to address concurrent session reliability. TRIAGE 2026-04-23: All four fixes shipped in 031-F (032-S). Contingency trigger condition not met. Deprioritized to low -- revisit only if multi-process contention recurs under real workloads. Effort: significant -- requires transport layer refactoring and process lifecycle management. Impact: high if needed -- eliminates the root cause of multi-process contention.

Follow-up to feature covering stash A9D74372 (Stage harvest docline hardening): (a) Direction 3 DEFERRED from that chore — change how the Stage harvest commit reaches the Ship feature branch so a Stage-artifact defect (beyond docline frontmatter, e.g. committed-file scope) cannot ride into a Ship PR. Options: Stage pushes its harvest commit to origin/main before Ship branches, or harvest lands via a dedicated delivery mechanism. Larger blast radius (branch/push topology, partly Ship-owned) — evaluate before implementing. (b) Upstream template drift: the docline frontmatter contract + pre-harvest lint gate were applied to the in-repo .github/skills/impl-plan/SKILL.md and harvest/SKILL.md, but the generating .tmpl sources live in the external autoharness repo; update them there (never via out-of-tree writes from this workspace, per Principle IV) so a regeneration does not overwrite the fix. Source: plan-review of docs/exec-plans/2026-07-02-stage-harvest-docline-frontmatter-hardening-plan.md, 2026-07-02.

Provision npm publishing credentials for @backlogit (EXTERNAL, human-only follow-up carved out of 080-S / stash 9140F65C in-repo slice): (1) provision the @backlogit org/scope on npmjs.org; (2) create an npm automation token with publish rights and add it as repo secret NPM_TOKEN. No agent (Stage or Ship) can perform these -- they require npm-org and repo-secret provisioning. Once done, the NPM_TOKEN presence guard shipped in task 080.001-T lets the release.yml npm-publish job's publish steps run automatically on the next release (no workflow change needed). Source: stash 9140F65C in-repo hygiene slice promoted as feature 080-F / shipment 080-S; external steps deferred 2026-07-04.
